title: Arabic basics
about: The most common words of written and spoken Arabic (wordfreq counts, grouped by dictionary word with tools/course/rank.mjs), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places are left out. Each word has one short everyday sentence that uses it the way native speakers do, fully vowelled, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word.
